propositions: pytest-xdist worker crashes with 'node down: Not properly terminated' on Python 3.11 when running test_matching_guard_is_accepted in opcert_service_app tests, blocking CI verification gate
asyncio.wait_for incorrectly consumes external cancellation on Python 3.11 when child task completes in same event loop turn, leaving worker task in cancelling state at queue.get()
worker process hangs indefinitely waiting for queue operation while lifespan shutdown awaits the task, eventually killed by pytest timeout at 300 seconds
replacing asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=T) with async context manager asyncio.timeout(...) restores correct cancellation semantics on Python 3.11
crash is load-dependent and reproduces deterministically under high CPU contention with concurrent suite runs
